_comment: QA-verification capture lane (SFT v3): the QA benchmark phrases executor objectives in test voice (an assertion-style title plus one 'Verify ...' sentence), and the executor must make the change, re-open or reload the page, confirm the state, and STOP on the screen that shows it. The corpus has no instructions in that voice and few done() steps that follow a re-check, so this lane captures teacher demonstrations of exactly that shape on sites that hold a signed-in session. task_style=qa_verify opts every site into the proposer's test-objective block, the teacher's re-open-and-confirm rules and the verifier's re-check criteria, and lands in metadata.json as task_style so the corpus audit can count the lane. Sessions come from credentials/storage_state/<storage_state_ref>.json (burner ids only, never a credential value here); affine is excluded because its IndexedDB-auth session injection fails; benchmark subjects are never included. Sites without a saved session run auth_mode=discovered and are skipped fail-closed until their burner id is registered in credentials/burner_accounts.json. Order matters: the sites whose sessions go stale fastest come first.

sites.name: leantime
sites.note: Run first: the leantime_session cookies (accounts.leantime.io and the workspace host) go stale fastest of the set, and the hosted 14-day trial opened 2026-08-26 ends around 2026-09-09. start_url is the burner's own workspace host (the storage_state's app origin), not accounts.leantime.io; refresh it from credentials/storage_state/leantime-auto-1.json if the burner is ever re-registered.

sites.name: toodledo
sites.note: Human-provisioned session: a server-side session cookie with no expiry stamp plus the tasks.toodledo.com IndexedDB, so it survives injection only while Toodledo keeps the session alive; run early. start_url is the app host, not the www marketing page.

sites.name: ticktick
sites.note: Best-proven session in the set: three autonomous pre_session captures succeeded on 2026-08-26 (trajectories/site_ticktick). The account already holds lists, a habit and Inbox tasks, so persisted-state tasks have existing content to act on.

sites.name: any-do
sites.note: Human-provisioned session: auth lives in the app.any.do localStorage plus six IndexedDB stores (needs the indexedDB-carrying storage_state path); start_url is the app origin because www.any.do carries none of the session. Free plan: boards and shared spaces are paid-only and password changes go through an emailed link.

sites.name: baserow
sites.note: Human-provisioned session. start_url stays /signup because every working capture used it: the injected session redirects straight into the burner's workspace (a Contacts database with Contacts and Companies tables, a Tasks database with a kanban view).

sites.name: firefly-iii
sites.note: Public demo instance behind the human-provisioned session; the host may reset demo data between runs, so tasks should create their own fixture before re-checking it.

sites.name: grist
sites.note: Generated burner from the autonomous lane. start_url is the app origin (docs.getgrist.com) rather than the /signup page the indie config starts on, so the injected session lands in the workspace.

sites.name: kitchenowl
sites.note: Human-provisioned session: auth is app.kitchenowl.org localStorage only (no cookies); start_url is the app root.

sites.name: mem
sites.note: Generated burner from the autonomous lane; auth spans mem.ai localStorage plus seven IndexedDB stores (needs the indexedDB-carrying path); start_url is the app origin, not the get.mem.ai marketing page. Mem signs in by magic link with no account password, so the sign-out/sign-in quota task cannot complete here and will be verifier-failed.

sites.name: openproject
sites.note: Generated burner from the autonomous lane. start_url is the burner's own trial tenant (the storage_state's only app origin); start.openproject.com is the marketing/trial-signup page and an injected tenant session does not apply there. The tenant already has a Sprint Board with work packages. Refresh the host from credentials/storage_state/openproject-auto-1.json if the burner is ever re-registered.

sites.name: slab
sites.note: Generated burner from the autonomous lane. start_url is the burner's workspace subdomain (the storage_state's app origin; auth is CapacitorStorage.authToken in that origin's localStorage); slab.com is the marketing site and costs steps to click through.

sites.name: worklenz
sites.note: Human-provisioned session (api.worklenz.sid valid to 2026-09-25 plus the app-origin localStorage session); start_url is the app root so the injected session lands in the workspace.

sites.name: vikunja
sites.note: Public demo instance with a shared demo login: register it as burner id vikunja-demo (never written here) and auth_mode=discovered signs in when the app blocks, then runs the two-phase task. Skipped fail-closed until that burner is registered. The host resets demo data periodically, so each task creates its own fixture.

sites.name: habitica
sites.note: Earlier corpus captures (trajectories/site_habitica) self-registered a per-run mail.tm identity that was not persisted; register or provision a burner under this id first, otherwise the site is skipped fail-closed.

sites.name: taiga
sites.note: Earlier corpus captures (trajectories/site_taiga) self-registered a per-run mail.tm identity that was not persisted; register or provision a burner under this id first, otherwise the site is skipped fail-closed.
